name: SC Simple Maintenance Toggle
author: Schwarz Creations

sections.description:
Put your WordPress site into maintenance mode with complete design control. Perfect for temporary site closures, updates, or coming soon pages with professional styling options.

Key Features

  • One-click activation from admin bar or settings
  • Custom backgrounds (color or image with blur effect)
  • Visual overlay controls (color and opacity adjustment)
  • Logo upload with size control
  • Custom text styling (heading and description colors)
  • Contact information display (email and phone)
  • Social media links integration
  • Role-based access control

Support

For assistance, visit Schwarz Creations

Developed by Schwarz Creations
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/sc-simple-maintenance-toggle
  2. Activate through WordPress admin → Plugins
  3. Configure under Settings → Maintenance Mode
  4. Toggle via admin bar or settings page
sections.faq:
How do I enable maintenance mode?

Toggle from either:
– The admin bar (top of screen when logged in)
– Settings → Maintenance Mode

What customization options are available?

Full control over:
– Background (color/image with blur)
– Overlay (color/opacity)
– Logo and sizing
– Text content and colors
– Contact information
– Social media links

Who can access the site during maintenance?

Administrators by default. You can specify additional user roles in settings.

Will this affect my search engine rankings?

No – the plugin uses proper 503 status codes to indicate temporary maintenance to search engines.
